source_pointer_scope: Each JSON Pointer is relative to the individual task object in its tasks.json file.

rubric_convention.required_slots: Every required slot must be answered semantically; verbatim wording is not required.
rubric_convention.optional_slots: Omission is allowed, but any asserted optional fact must be correct.
rubric_convention.extra_claims: Any other material factual claim must be supported by the user request and accepted tool results.
rubric_convention.identifiers: Harmless spacing or hyphenation variation is allowed only when identity is unchanged.
